authored.title: نسيتُ أن
authored.explanation_ar: نستخدم forgot to لفعل مقصود أو مطلوب لم نؤده في الوقت المقصود، وقد نتذكره ونؤديه لاحقًا. يلي to الفعل الأساسي.
authored.explanation_en: Use forgot to plus a base verb for an intended action you failed to perform at the intended time. You may remember and do it later.
authored.contrast_ar: I forgot to call = لم أتصل؛ I remembered calling = أتذكر أنني اتصلت.
authored.contrast_en: Forgot to do means the intended action was not performed. Forgot doing means losing the memory of an action that happened, a different meaning.
